name: courseio
description: Create complete educational courses for your students and export them to your LMS.

interface.longDescription:
CourseIO helps teachers, lecturers and professors create complete online courses for their students. Give it a topic, and it builds lessons with a teaching script, slides, captions, a narrated video, a quiz for each module and a handout. You can then export the course to your school's, college's or university's learning platform.

With CourseIO in ChatGPT, you can:
- Create a course: describe the topic, who it's for (for example, Year 9 science, an A-level revision course or a first-year university module) and how many lessons you want.
- Improve a lesson: read a lesson's script or slides, make it clearer, and save the changes you approve.
- Update a video: after a lesson changes, rebuild that lesson's video.
- Translate a course: make a copy of a course in another language.
- Export a course: download it as SCORM, cmi5, Common Cartridge or Moodle for your LMS.
- Check your work: see your courses and their lessons.

You stay in control:
- Nothing that uses your CourseIO credits happens until you confirm it.
- You choose which CourseIO organisation ChatGPT can use, and you can disconnect at any time in CourseIO under Settings > Connected apps.
- CourseIO only receives the requests ChatGPT sends on your behalf. It never sees your conversation.

Editing, rebuilding and translating need Course Studio to be turned on for your organisation. You need a CourseIO account to connect.
capabilities: Create a complete course from a topic, with scripts, slides, quizzes and handouts
Read and improve lesson scripts, slides, captions and handouts
Rebuild a lesson's video after changes
Translate a course into another language
Export courses to Moodle, Canvas or Blackboard (SCORM, cmi5, Common Cartridge)
Show your courses and their lessons
defaultPrompt: Create a 4-lesson course on photosynthesis for Year 9 students
List my CourseIO courses and what each one covers
Export my latest course as SCORM for Moodle

positive.expected_behavior: Replies with the organisation's name and its lesson credit balance (50 on the test account). Nothing is changed or charged.

positive.prompt: List my CourseIO courses and show me the script of the first lesson in the Serverless RAG course.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the account's courses, finds 'Serverless RAG From Concept To Business Impact' and shows the script of its first lesson. Read only.

positive.description: Price and create a new course
positive.prompt: Create a 2-lesson course on the water cycle for Year 7 students, about 3 minutes per lesson.
positive.expected_behavior: Quotes the course first (2 lesson credits) and asks the user to confirm. After confirmation, creates the course, says generation has started and gives a link to it in CourseIO.

positive.description: Improve a lesson and update its video
positive.prompt: Make the first lesson of the Serverless RAG course a little simpler for beginners, then update its video.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the script, proposes a simpler version, saves it once the user agrees, quotes the rebuild and, after confirmation, starts rebuilding that lesson's video.

positive.description: Export a course for an LMS
positive.prompt: Export the Serverless RAG course as a SCORM package for Moodle.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts a free export of the course and, when it is ready, returns a download link for the SCORM package.

negative.description: General knowledge question unrelated to CourseIO
negative.prompt: What is the capital of Australia?

negative.description: Creative writing with no course involved
negative.prompt: Write a short poem about autumn leaves.
Book me a table for two at an Italian restaurant tonight.

publication.release_notes: First release of CourseIO for ChatGPT: create, improve, translate and export educational courses for your students.
